sentences.en: In the morning, I go out and see grandpa at the doorway.
Grandpa says, "Morning! Morning to you too!"
I go to school, and on the way I see my friend Xiaomei.
Xiaomei says, "Good morning! Let's eat lunch together at noon, OK?"
I say, "Sure! See you at noon!"
At noon, Xiaomei and I eat lunch together, and we say, "See you tonight!"

quiz.q: What is a short, casual way to say "good morning"?
What do the narrator and Xiaomei plan to do at noon?
What do they say when parting after lunch?

grammar.p: 早上好 vs 早 — two ways to say good morning
grammar.e: 早上好 is the full morning greeting; 早 alone is a shorter, casual way to say the same thing.
grammar.x: 早！你也早！— Morning! Morning to you too!

grammar.p: time word + 见 — arranging to meet again
grammar.e: Put a time word like 中午 or 晚上 before 见 to say when you'll see someone again.
grammar.x: 中午见！— See you at noon!

grammar.p: 上午/中午/晚上 — parts of the day
grammar.e: These words mark different times of day and pair with different greetings or plans.
grammar.x: 中午一起吃饭，好吗？— Let's eat lunch together at noon, OK?
